title: What Mily Unlimited Is
author: Miłosz
content:
It all started with a single project

Over the past few years I worked on many different ideas.

Some were about software, others about electronics, others about artificial intelligence or simple experiments that never reached a wider audience.

At first glance they were completely independent projects. Over time, however, I noticed that they were all heading in the same direction.

Why was Mily Unlimited created?

I felt the need for a single place that would bring together all my current and future projects.

A shared space where I can document my work, share my experiences, and develop new initiatives.

“The best app is the one you’d want to use yourself. And you’ll never finish building it”

What will you find on this site?

Mily Unlimited is the place where I publish: software and electronics projects, AI experiments, project prototypes, and the lessons and reflections that come from building all of it.

Not every project will become a finished product, and a great many will most likely never even be published. Still. Every major project starts with an idea, an experiment, and a first prototype.

Looking ahead

Today, Mily Unlimited is my personal initiative. Perhaps one day it will become something much bigger. Whatever the future looks like, the goal stays the same:

To create practical solutions in software, electronics, and artificial intelligence, while never ceasing to learn and to share the entire process of making them.

Welcome to Mily Unlimited.
